name: Shota Yuusha no Junan 6 ~Hashire Yuusha!! Tsukamattara Aa na Koto ni Kamishibai-shiki Adventure Game~
original_name: ショタ勇者の受難6 ～走れ勇者っ!! 捕まったらアーッなことにっ 紙芝居式 アドベンチャーゲーム～
source:
The story continues from Shota Hero Agony 5! 

* You can enjoy this game standalone. 

The incubus in the woods isn't the hero's only problem. 
It's too powerful to fight. He can flee, but which way?

A simple choice & evasion game :) 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE173232.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
故事承接《少年英雄的苦难5》！森林里的梦魔并不是英雄唯一的问题，它强大到无法战斗。英雄可以逃跑，但该往哪边走？一款简单的选择与躲避游戏。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE173232.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
